What impossible hypothesis should we tes.text: Home · Your analyses · Guest demo session Leave demo Alphabet Inc. What impossible hypothesis should we test? The workflow that Alphabet Inc.'s product sits inside may stop existing rather than be improved.: It sells to its Google Cloud customers. A product priced against a human process captures a share of that process's cost; when the process is performed by a machine end to end, the customer is no longer buying a better way to do it, and there is nothing left for the price to be a share of.; Alphabet Inc.'s most important competitor may be its own customers deciding to do this themselves.: It charges on consumption-based fees and subscriptions for infrastructure, platform, applications, and other cloud services. A charge that scales with the customer's own volume grows into a line item large enough to justify a build, and the largest customers reach that threshold first — which are the same accounts the revenue depends on most.; Within Google Services may be structurally unable to answer a move here, which would make the contested position far cheaper to take than a symmetric reading implies.: Within Google Services was established as a competitor from disclosure rather than assumed.
